description.en: Demonstrates all 4 lifecycle hooks (on_install, on_before_upgrade, on_after_upgrade, on_uninstall) by appending timestamped entries to /storage/lifecycle.log
description.de: Demonstriert alle 4 Lifecycle-Hooks (on_install, on_before_upgrade, on_after_upgrade, on_uninstall) durch zeitgestempelte Einträge in /storage/lifecycle.log
